4.1.rationale_en: The text states that PMDA investigates whether the manufacturer has a mechanism ('仕組みになっているかどうか') to conform to QMS and produce products of proper quality. This implies the existence and implementation of a QMS, but does not detail all requirements for establishment, maintenance, or continual improvement.

4.1.english_translation: PMDA investigates whether the manufacturer or registered manufacturing site of medical devices or in vitro diagnostic medical devices has a mechanism to conform to QMS (Quality Management System) regarding manufacturing control and quality management, and produce products of proper quality.
